text:
# Pre-market brief, Thu 2026-11-05 (~8:25 AM ET)

1. **Futures mixed after blue-wave rally.** Dow e-minis +0.5–0.7%, S&P ~flat/+0.1–0.2%, Nasdaq 100 −0.5–0.9% as chips/data-center stay heavy ([Investing/Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/sp-500-futures-steady-after-midterm-rally-nasdaq-lags-on-chip-weakness-5003237); [Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket); [X](https://x.com/i/trending/2118328477485240356)).
2. **QCOM −9 to −10% pre:** handset chip sales −26% to $5.14B; FQ1 guide $10.4–11.2B / EPS $2.15–2.35 soft vs est. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-qualcomm-snap-slide-premarket-unity-surges-5003847); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-shak-wen-pton-u.html)). Semis group stays in avoid through 11/06.
3. **Other losers:** SNAP −9.8% (rev $1.72B / DAU 495M miss); EXPE ~−7% (soft Q4 rev guide); Z ~−15% miss; BROS −13.7% (FY guide miss); MNTN ~−45% (FY cut) ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-qualcomm-snap-slide-premarket-unity-surges-5003847); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-shak-wen-pton-u.html)).
4. **Gap winners (skip open per >5% rule):** U +22%, APP +19% (beat/raise), WRBY +22%, EPAM +13.6% beat-and-raise, PTON +7.3% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-qualcomm-snap-slide-premarket-unity-surges-5003847); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-shak-wen-pton-u.html)).
5. **Oil/BTC/gold:** Brent rebounded ~$96 (still near 2-mo lows after −8.7% Wed); BTC ~$79.6–80.4k; gold ~$4,124–4,153; 10-yr ~4.88% ([Bloomberg/swissinfo](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/stock-rotation-rolls-on-as-chipmakers-retreat%3A-markets-wrap/92330151); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/11/05/live-updates-bitcoin-steady-around-usd80-000-as-markets-rally-after-democratic-sweep); [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/democratic-takeover-sends-gold-above-4-128-bitcoin-holds-80-300-202611050833)).
6. **Today:** claims + Q3 productivity 8:30 ([Finviz](https://finviz.com/calendar/economic/detail/IJCUSA); [BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched_list.htm)). AMC: ABNB, NET, AFRM, DKNG, LYFT ([TiltRadar](https://tiltradar.com/earnings)). Fri: October jobs 8:30.

## Swing ideas
- **CI** long, med. Adj EPS $7.98, raised FY adj EPS to ≥$30.60; ~+3.6% pre ([Cigna IR](https://newsroom.thecignagroup.com/2026-11-05-The-Cigna-Group-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results,-Raises-2026-Outlook); [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/cigna-shares-climb-on-raised-earnings-outlook-q3-beat-5003087)). Risk: managed-care policy under Dem Congress; pharmacy/behavioral customer attrition.
- **CAH** long, med. Non-GAAP EPS $3.26 (+28%), FY non-GAAP EPS raised to $12.80–13.00; ~+2.8% pre ([CAH IR](https://newsroom.cardinalhealth.com/2026-11-05-Cardinal-Health-Reports-First-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2027-Results-and-Raises-Outlook)). Risk: GMPD profit −28%; opioid/litigation; pharma pricing.
- **PLNT** long, low. Adj EPS $0.83 / rev $360M beat; raised FY same-club/rev/EBITDA; +1.2% pre ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/planet-fitness-shares-tank-despite-beatandraise-quarter-new-500m-buyback-5003670); [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/planet-fitness-inc-announces-third-quarter-2026-results-302929933.html)). Risk: equipment-placement cut; consumer discretionary softness.
